format: newly constructed KFC outlet (traditional dine-in and carryout, single Franchise Agreement), land purchased

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a newly constructed KFC outlet ranges from $2,107,575 to $4,155,000. This includes $48,575 to $50,500 that must be paid to KFCLLC or its affiliates.

fee.quote: Initial Franchise Fee. KFCLLC charges an initial franchise fee of $45,000. ... You must pay the initial franchise fee in two parts: (i) the Deposit Fee; and (ii) the Option Fee.
fee.note: Paid as a $20,000 Deposit Fee and a $25,000 Option Fee. Plus training fee of $3,000 per person (if trained at a Company-Owned Outlet) and background check fee of $575 to $2,500 per person. Development Agreement: $45,000 per committed Outlet ($135,000 to $540,000 for 3 to 12 Outlets).

royalty.flat: minimum of $1,440 per month, whichever is greater
royalty.quote: Royalty (Note 2) 4% to 5.25% of Gross Revenue or a minimum of $1,440, whichever is greater, per month (minimum fee subject to adjustment based upon the Consumer Price Index).

adFund.quote: National Co-Op (Note 4) 5.8% of Gross Revenue. ... your national advertising contribution rate is 5.8% during the Comeback Period. After the Comeback Period ends and through December 31, 2028, your national advertising contribution rate will be 4.5%
adFund.note: 5.8% during the Comeback Period (October 1, 2025 through March 31, 2027), then 4.5% through December 31, 2028, then reverts to 2% from January 1, 2029 unless changed under the National Co-Op By-Laws.

otherRecurring.name: Technology Fees
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $297.39 per Outlet per month (anticipated to increase to up to $450.63; not to exceed $3,000 per Outlet per month)

otherRecurring.name: One System Fund Fee
otherRecurring.amount: $180 per Outlet per month (plus applicable tax and shipping)

otherRecurring.name: Digital Fee
otherRecurring.amount: 3.1% of Gross Revenue collected from all Digital Orders

transferFee.amount: Transfer to a new KFCLLC franchisee: $9,600 for the first Outlet and $4,800 for each additional Outlet in the same transaction (to an existing franchisee: $4,800 for the first Outlet and $2,400 for each additional Outlet)
